scope: Independent semantic/source review of other authors only; not full package acceptance or a final Git-head review.
findings: FiniteDataSource uses one Param for actual risk, selection actions, baseline, conditioning and deployment; constant observation has no state leak. Training reset/readout is separate.

Actual initial preparation is initial.bind of the existing selection action mixture; cemetery mass is retained. Controller risk weight is zero, prefinal selection tilt comes from the empirical risk rates, last step uses fair action weights.

FiniteDataConditioned derives the same-source survival normalization mean^T, positive-horizon initial tilt, and safe conditional rows from actual killed risk matrix. Full target_eq_actual reuses generated_ambient_eq_actual; target identity is not an assumed premise. Unreachable outside rows use an explicit totalization and are not action-capability extensions.

FiniteDataPathBounds carries the SAME specified policy/literal table. Its occupied-row restriction uses actual target-positive histories, not empirical zeros. Shared-kernel contraction and target-weighted extension yield a whole-path bound. The rank-one final-fair step contributes no extra target mismatch.
FiniteDataControl derives physical selection row masses and noisy preparation TV from source transitions. The structural cemetery zero belongs to target support, not an empirical estimate.

FiniteDataCertificate compares actual deployment to empirical ideal target, then empirical target to true same-source target. The actual noise term is bounded on Good by empirical max noise plus radius; the T-fold risk-tilt error uses normalized_tilt_error. This yields the registered preparation-inclusive budget without a selected-model fit premise.

selector.py derives target and residuals from the reference source, binds one preparation table and one time-dependent returned table, and computes exact Fraction decision budgets/floors. It never reads generator-private truth or Good.

batch.py freezes complete records and seed commitments before one sample attempt; exclusive start marker prevents reruns. Accept/reject records are retained; rejected records do not deploy. Actual accepted traces preserve prepreparation state/action and all T+1 operations, including absorbing failure.

The two previously identified source-level integration obligations are resolved in the recorded current source bytes. The generic rare-event bound remains honest and can be vacuous at T10; the structural route supplies the useful short-horizon certificate without changing the original event or action set.

limits: Sampling-interface assumptions are explicit: PRNG stream/source faithfulness is not a formal proof of physical iid sampling.
Statistical Good is a quantified event, not a flag visible to the selector; retrospective evaluator Good diagnostics do not upgrade statistical claims to exact true-parameter certificates.
Full-path equality at e=0 and approximation at e>0 remain distinct. This review does not establish external scientific validation or general search completeness.

resolved_integration_obligations.item: Full T+1 record to deployed-window identity
resolved_integration_obligations.resolution: FiniteDataLiteral.full_experiment_window_eq_literal derives original-state/preparation-action/preparation-state retained joint marginal and whole future action/state erasure by actual PMF bind/map identities; no success filtering or suffix-law hypothesis.

FiniteDataGeneralRoute.source_row_tv_le and baseline_source_bound derive all-action TV and the original action/state baseline perturbation from the same four Good errors. general_target_stability uses the original survival event and existing conditioned_readout_tv_le_reference_mass with exact reference survival mean^T. general_approximation composes the preparation-inclusive physical source noise charge, empirical radius and rare-event target term.

FiniteDataCertifiedConsumer.full_record_statistical_certificate concerns the SAME literal prep/table and its actual full-record projection versus true source actualConditionedPrefix, under scalar Good; no alternate policy choice or supplied target identity.
FiniteDataSource.zero_noise_path_eq follows from proved zero full-path TV through finite half-L1. It retains same controller and does not promote noisy approximation to equality.
